source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: "southern urbanism" OR "southern urban theory" OR "urban theory from the South" OR "ordinary cities"
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:"southern urbanism" OR "southern urban theory" OR "urban theory from the South" OR "ordinary cities",is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has ("ordinary cities" OR "southern urban theory" OR "southern urbanism" OR "urban theory from the South")
